--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,PeriodStartTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode, COUNT(1) CNT
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
GROUP BY CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,PeriodStartTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE 
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,PeriodStartTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode ORDER BY CustomerId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , 
* INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber_WITH_DUP_20230816
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber_WITH_DUP_20230816 
--3557541

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
--3557541


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
SELECT  
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,TelephoneNumberNote
,LocationId
,TextCapableIndicator
,ExtensionNumber
,DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest
,AreaCode
,CountryCode
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber_WITH_DUP_20230816
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,PeriodStartTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
GROUP BY CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,PeriodStartTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber_WITH_DUP_20230816
--3557541
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
--3557541
